const test=require('node:test'),assert=require('node:assert/strict'),path=require('node:path'),{pathToFileURL}=require('node:url');
const primary=[[Date.UTC(2020,0,1)/1000,100,102,99,101,100],[Date.UTC(2020,0,2)/1000,101,103,100,102,100]],history=[-1,0].map(i=>[Date.UTC(2020,0,i+1),'90','92','89','91','50',Date.UTC(2020,0,i+2)-1,'500',2,'30','300','0']);
const yahoo={chart:{result:[{timestamp:history.map(r=>r[0]/1000),indicators:{quote:[{open:[90,90],high:[92,92],low:[89,89],close:[91,91],volume:[50,50]}]}}]}};
async function run(variant,mode,symbol='BTCUSDT',interval='day'){
 const original=global.fetch,saved=global.caches,savedNow=Date.now,calls=[];Date.now=()=>Date.UTC(2026,9,2);global.caches={default:{match:async()=>null,put:async()=>{}}};
 global.fetch=async input=>{const u=new URL(typeof input==='string'?input:input.url);calls.push(u.href);if(u.hostname==='invented.bank.test')return Response.json({warehouse_empty:false,warehouse_key:symbol==='AAPL'?'invented/equity':'invented/crypto-bars/BTC.json',source_span:'day',source_mult:1,bars:primary});if(u.hostname==='query1.finance.yahoo.com'){if(mode==='error')return Response.json({error:'invented failure'},{status:503});return Response.json(mode==='yahoo'?yahoo:{chart:{result:[]}});}if(u.hostname==='api.binance.com')return Response.json(mode==='none'?[]:history);throw Error('unexpected '+u);};
 try{const worker=(await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(__dirname,variant==='before'?'fixtures/worker-crypto-source/predecessor/index.js':'../cloudflare/workers/justhodl-data-proxy/src/index.js')))).default,r=await worker.fetch(new Request('https://invented.worker.test/ohlc?ticker='+symbol+'&span='+interval+'&days=12000'),{SYMDIR_URL:'https://invented.bank.test'},{waitUntil:()=>{}});return {status:r.status,sourceHeader:r.headers.get('X-Source'),packet:await r.json(),calls};}finally{global.fetch=original;global.caches=saved;Date.now=savedNow;}
}
for(const mode of ['yahoo','empty','error'])test('full route names '+mode+' supplement and preserves every bar',async()=>{
 const old=await run('before',mode),current=await run('candidate',mode),source=mode==='yahoo'?'yahoo':'binance';assert.equal(current.status,200);assert.deepEqual(current.packet.bars,old.packet.bars);assert.deepEqual(current.calls,old.calls);assert.equal(current.packet.source,'warehouse+'+source);assert.equal(current.sourceHeader,current.packet.source);assert.equal(current.packet.history_source,source);assert.equal(current.packet.history_n,2);assert.equal(current.packet.history_added_n,1);assert.equal(current.packet.yahoo_n,source==='yahoo'?2:0);assert.equal(current.packet.binance_n,source==='binance'?2:0);assert.equal(current.packet.warehouse_n,2);assert.equal(current.packet.bars[1].close,101);assert.match(current.packet.history_join_policy,/remain unverified/);
 const normalized={...current.packet};for(const k of ['history_source','history_n','history_added_n','history_join_policy','binance_n'])delete normalized[k];normalized.source=old.packet.source;normalized.yahoo_n=old.packet.yahoo_n;assert.deepEqual(normalized,old.packet);
});
for(const [mode,symbol,interval,count] of [['none','BTCUSDT','day',3],['yahoo','AAPL','day',1],['yahoo','BTCUSDT','week',1]])test('no supplement path '+[mode,symbol,interval].join('/'),async()=>{const old=await run('before',mode,symbol,interval),current=await run('candidate',mode,symbol,interval);assert.equal(current.status,200);assert.deepEqual(current,old);assert.equal(current.calls.length,count);assert.equal(current.packet.source,'warehouse');assert.equal(current.packet.history_source,undefined);});

test('complete predecessor modules and exact single-function change remain inspectable',()=>{const fs=require('node:fs'),crypto=require('node:crypto'),D=path.join(__dirname,'fixtures/worker-crypto-source'),inventory=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(D,'predecessor-inventory.json'),'utf8')),hash=x=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(x).digest('hex');for(const [name,row] of Object.entries(inventory)){const raw=fs.readFileSync(path.join(D,'predecessor',name));assert.equal(raw.length,row.bytes);assert.equal(hash(raw),row.sha256);}const t=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(D,'transition.json'),'utf8')),before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(D,'predecessor/index.js'),'utf8'),current=fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'..',t.path),'utf8');assert.equal(hash(before),t.source_sha256);assert.equal(before.split(t.before).length,2);assert.equal(current,before.replace(t.before,t.after));assert.equal(hash(current),t.candidate_sha256);});

test('existing whole-worker preservation keeps every assertion through one exact source-bound hook',()=>{const fs=require('node:fs'),crypto=require('node:crypto'),D=path.join(__dirname,'fixtures/worker-crypto-source'),hash=s=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex'),t=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(D,'test-hook.json'),'utf8')),old=fs.readFileSync(path.join(D,'symsearch-test-before.js.txt'),'utf8');assert.equal(hash(old),t.before_sha256);assert.equal(old.split(t.before).length,2);const raw=fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'..',t.path),'utf8');assert.equal(raw,old.replace(t.before,t.after));assert.equal(hash(raw),t.after_sha256);});
